title: WEATHER FORECAST FOR 01 March 2026 Issued at 2.00 p.m. on 28 February 2026 Mainly fair weather will prevail over the most parts of the island. Misty conditions can be expected at some places in Western, Sabaragamuwa, Central, Southern and North-western provinces and in Anuradhapura and Monaragala districts during the early hours of the morning.
